answer: The crystal multiplier is published, charged in mirror, and orchard lists each payment. A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 12 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 1609 identities would post 4143 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
